# Hugo Ferrer · B2B product designer · From MVP to product, AI-ready design systems

## About

Hugo Ferrer is a B2B product designer based in Paris, France.
Works on B2B SaaS products, public sector services (DSFR, RGAA) and internal business tools.

## Key Projects

- Délicorner (B2B foodtech, freelance mission): Corner Digital client portal and a design system built from scratch in 2 weeks, then CX Copilot, an anti-churn Slack AI bot. https://www.designeruxuihugo.com/delico%20projet/delicorner-preview.html

- Gouvernement.fr: UX/UI work at the Government Information Service (SIG) on info.gouv.fr: DSFR and RGAA audit, redesigned priority policy journeys, mockups and design system contributions. Live site: https://www.info.gouv.fr/

- AgoraSquare: B2B platform redesign for Rungis market wholesalers. Digital transformation combining order management, solvency checks, electronic invoicing, and accounting. https://www.designeruxuihugo.com/agorasquare-good.html

- Data Collection (B2B SaaS, client name withheld): discovery and design of document collection for an HR and finance consulting firm: eight user interviews, then four user journeys (sales, client, manager, consultant) to request, upload, check and follow up on payroll and HR documents. https://www.designeruxuihugo.com/data-collection.html

## Expertise

- UX Research & Strategy
- UI Design & Prototyping
- Design Systems (including DSFR for French government)
- Accessibility compliance (RGAA/WCAG standards)
- Figma, Design Tokens, Component Libraries
